bio: BabyRiiri (say it baby-rii-ri) is a singer and rapper from Lusaka, Zambia. She started making music when she was six and writes her own songs, turning her thoughts and feelings into lyrics. Her sound mixes cheerful energy with soulful depth. She's mentored by her brother, Matty Maverick, and she's always learning and growing. Always be hopeful.
name: BabyRiiri
tagline: Bright, hopeful music for every heart.
